title: Bell with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M50 12 C32 12 24 30 22 50 L18 70 C17 74 20 78 24 78 L76 78 C80 78 83 74 82 70 L78 50 C76 30 68 12 50 12 Z' fill='#FFD84D' stroke='#F0B800' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bell shine -->
  <path d='M38 20 C32 28 28 42 27 56' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bell rim -->
  <rect x='14' y='74' width='72' height='10' rx='5' fill='#FFC107' stroke='#E0A800' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='6' fill='#FF8A65' stroke='#E64A19' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='86' r='2' fill='#FFAB91'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='48' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='48' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 60 Q50 72 62 60' fill='none' stroke='#3E2723' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='58' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFAB91' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- top loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#F0B800' stroke-width='3'/>
</svg>
